text.en: A ball flies from one friend to another. Throwing and catching use the arms, shoulders and torso, and the hands release and catch the object.

To throw: hold the ball firmly with fingers spread out. Face the target.
Run 3 to 4 steps and place your strong foot on the ground. This builds the force for the throw.
Swing the throwing arm backwards while twisting your waist, then bring the arm forward, follow through with your other foot and release the ball.
The follow-through should be smooth and without a jerk.
To catch: stand relaxed with eyes on the ball. Run to where the ball will land, keep your body behind the line of the ball and make a cup with your hands.
Let the ball come into your hands softly. Bring the hands slightly back and bend the knees to reduce the force.
For a high ball, stand with knees slightly bent, join your palms above your head to form a reverse cup, keep your head still and eyes up and catch softly.
The book has games like Hush Hush Throw to practise throwing, with a defender in the circle and a soft ball. Play in teams and have fun.

problem.en: Which step comes first when throwing: swinging the arm back or holding the ball firmly?

text.en: Hold the ball firmly with fingers spread out.
Then swing back, twist the waist, throw and follow through.

prompt.en: How do you catch a ball safely?

requiredIdeas.en: Cup your hands and keep the body behind the ball
Let it come in softly and bend the knees

points.en: Throw: firm grip, run 3-4 steps, twist, swing and follow through.
Catch: eyes on the ball, cup hands, soft hands, bend knees.
